o.text: From Proto-Common Turkic *bedük (“big, high”), whence also Azerbaijani böyütmək (“to raise”) and böyümək (“to grow”). Cognate with Turkish büyük etc.
From Persian مهمانخانه (mehmânxâne). By surface analysis, mehman (“guest”) + -xana (“house; place”).
Izafet II compound of damaq + orta. Calque of Russian средненёбный (srednenjóbnyj).
